phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor is the closure of the covering congruence system over the surviving class n=1 mod 24, bounded by the irreducibility of the uncovered residual.

AFWD.chosen_element: Forward morphism assigning each (modulus,residue,rung) triple to a sub-progression of n=1 mod 24
AFWD.justification: Each triple maps forward into a specific residue class within the surviving class, extending coverage.

AREV.chosen_element: Reverse descent from a candidate triple back to its modulus and residue constraints
AREV.justification: Verification descends from a proposed triple to confirm it respects the modulus-residue structure of the class.

CLINK.chosen_element: Sequential composition chaining triples into a cumulative covering relation
CLINK.justification: Triples are composed in sequence to build the aggregate covering relation over the class.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Both coverage and non-coverage held simultaneously for the residual
ENGAGR.justification: The residual is both covered and irreducible at once, a live contradiction in the paraconsistent sense.

EVALF.chosen_element: Negative arm where the triple fails to cover the target sub-progression
EVALF.justification: Constructive refutation that the triple leaves a gap in the class.

EVALT.chosen_element: Affirmative arm where the triple successfully covers a sub-progression
EVALT.justification: Constructive proof that the triple contributes to covering part of n=1 mod 24.

FFUSE.chosen_element: Fuse the covered and uncovered arms into a single verdict on the residual
FFUSE.justification: The arms rejoin into one resolved state: either the residual is fully covered or it remains irreducible.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Split on whether a given triple covers part of the surviving class n=1 mod 24
FSPLIT.justification: The system forks into a covered arm and an uncovered arm based on each triple's contribution.

IFIX.chosen_element: Permanent append-only record of each triple and its coverage status
IFIX.justification: Once a triple is fixed into the system, its contribution is irreversibly recorded.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: Self-referential identity of a triple within the system
IMSCRIB.justification: A triple is itself; its identity is preserved under composition and evaluation.

TANCH.chosen_element: Terminal boundary enclosing the full covering congruence system and its verdict on n=1 mod 24
TANCH.justification: The system is sealed once the congruence triples are fixed and the residual class is either covered or declared irreducible.

VINIT.chosen_element: Empty congruence system with no modulus-residue-rung triples assigned
VINIT.justification: No covering has been constructed; the system begins with no triples and no established coverage over any class.
